images.alt: Night at the star tower: Queen Sunduk reaches for a falling star, its red light on her face; far below in the dark, Yushin looks up at her and not at the sky
images.prompt: Love. Night, almost black. Over-the-shoulder shot: in the lower-left foreground, out of focus and nearly all black, the shoulder and bearded jaw of Kim Yushin (RIGHT face) looking up; only the line of his jaw catches faint red, his eyes ordinary and in shadow, NOT glowing. In the midground right, sharp, Queen Sunduk (LEFT face) leans on the stone parapet of the granite star tower (Cheomseongdae) in close-medium profile, her eyes at the vertical centre of the frame and her Silla crown well below the top edge, one hand lifted toward a single falling star streaking vermilion #E8552B across the upper-left sky. The star is the only key: SPLIT LIGHTING, it lights the near half of her face (cheekbone, lashes, parted lips), her fingertips and a few gold spangles of the crown; the far half of her face, her robe and the tower are pure black. Longing, distance. CANON: QUEEN SUNDUK — FACE and garments from the LEFT panel of the attached sheet (face only; invent a new pose). Hair ornament matches the canon description when the head is visible. Look: Pale oval face, dark calm eyes; black hair in a full coiled updo; when crowned, the gold Silla tree-and-antler crown hung with jade gogok. Dress: Crimson court robe with gold phoenix brocade, blue embroidered cape-collar, a red ribbon bow at the chest. Crown: Silla gold crown exactly as the attached museum photo (Cheonmachong / Hwangnamdaechong, 27 to 36 cm tall, as tall again as the face): an OPEN crown with no cap or lining, the hair and topknot showing through it. A NARROW flat gold headband (about a thumb wide) sits level on the forehead. Rising from it, THREE flat sheet-gold tree uprights, one at the centre front and one over each ear: each is a straight vertical stem whose short straight side-branches turn UP at right angles in three or four stacked tiers (like 出), every tip a small bud or heart. At the BACK, two shorter flat antler-shaped uprights angle outward with alternating branches, seen behind the tree uprights, never curling out like horns at the sides. Every upright and the band is hung on fine gold wires with hundreds of small round trembling gold spangles and many curved pale-green jade gogok. From the band at each temple, a long pendant chain of gold leaf-shapes falls past the cheek to the collarbone. Thin, bright, pale gold-silver sheet that trembles and catches light. NEVER a solid basket, never a castle battlement or fence, never horns or deer antlers curving at the sides, never a cap inside, never a European spiked crown or tiara. ref_muyeol shows it worn with the king's red robe and gold-scroll collar (ignore its painted backdrop). Demeanor: Composed, faint smile, wit in the eyes; looks up at the sky (Cheomseongdae). Never weepy, never cowed. #E8552B as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: Tang empress costume; fantasy tiara in place of the Silla gold crown. | KIM YUSHIN — FACE and garments from the RIGHT panel of the attached sheet (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Tall, broad-shouldered, long black hair in a high topknot-ponytail with trailing Silla-blue cloth tails; level hard brows, deep-set eyes. Dress: Silla-blue po and trousers, plum-violet sash knotted at the waist, white inner collar, dark wrapped forearms. Off duty: plain blue po, no jewelry. Now: Marshal: full black beard and moustache; a blue ribbon in the topknot instead of the headband. Demeanor: Confucian: he STANDS — never sits in lotus. Weighs, counts, frowns at sums; tight jaw, rare dry half-smile. Grief shows as stillness, not tears. The most feared warrior in all of Samhan: a line goes quiet when the tall Silla helm and the white horse appear. Massive, deliberate, terrifying at a walk; by Hwangsan (65) heavier and slower than Gyebek but still the man armies are built around. #2A5FB8 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: sitting in lotus or holding prayer beads; katana, tsuba or curved blade (ignore the sword drawn on his portrait); two swords at once; blue glow aura. HEEWON STYLE, dark register: Korean webtoon figures with bold tapered ink line, painted into a sumukhwa ink-wash and oil-glaze world (splashed ink, dry-brush, hanji grain, umber-indigo glazes). DEEP TENEBRISM (Caravaggio, La Tour): at least 80% of the frame is pure ink-black. Each figure first reads as a dark mass merging into the black background; then ONE narrow hard key light from the side or below reveals only a sliver of the real face (one eye, the ridge of a cheekbone, the line of a jaw) plus a hand or the edge of a crown or blade. SPLIT LIGHTING on every face: one side lit, the other side pure black, the eyes on the dark side lost. blocks.html: Back when tigers used to smoke...
blocks.ko: 호랑이 담배 피우던 시절…

blocks.html: Heaven sent down a man to the earth.
blocks.ko: 하늘이 사람 하나를 땅으로 내려보냈다.

blocks.html: He fell in love with a woman and produced a son, who established the first kingdom.
blocks.ko: 그는 한 여인과 사랑에 빠져 아들을 낳았고, 그 아들이 첫 나라를 세웠다.

blocks.html: He ruled as the Wanggum — the King for All, and established cordial relations with all peoples, north, south, east, west.
blocks.ko: 그는 왕검, 곧 모두의 왕으로 다스리며 동서남북 모든 백성과 사이좋게 지냈다.

blocks.html: Then... invasion! In 108 BC, A new Emperor arose in the west, sent an army, and destroyed the kingdom.
blocks.ko: 그러다… 침략! 기원전 108년, 서쪽에서 새 황제가 일어나 군대를 보내 그 나라를 무너뜨렸다.

blocks.html: The people fled in all directions as refugees, establishing dozens of small new kingdoms. Eventually, three great kingdoms arose among them.
blocks.ko: 백성은 사방으로 흩어져 피란길에 올랐고, 수십 개의 작은 나라를 새로 세웠다. 마침내 그 가운데 세 큰 나라가 일어섰다.

blocks.html: In the mountains of the north... Five Tribes came together to form the kingdom of Goguryeo.
blocks.ko: 북쪽 산골에서는… 다섯 부족이 모여 고구려를 세웠다.

blocks.html: In the plains of the southeast... Six Elders elected a new leader to form the kingdom of Silla.
blocks.ko: 동남쪽 들판에서는… 여섯 촌장이 새 지도자를 뽑아 신라를 세웠다.

blocks.html: In the coasts of the southwest... Ten Attendants migrated down to form the kingdom of Baekje.
blocks.ko: 서남쪽 바닷가에서는… 열 신하가 남쪽으로 내려와 백제를 세웠다.

blocks.html: Together, they came to be known as Samhan (the Three Hans).
blocks.ko: 이 세 나라를 함께 일러 삼한이라 했다.

blocks.label: 7th Century AD
blocks.ko: 7세기

blocks.caption: Three kingdoms, one peninsula.
blocks.ko: 세 나라, 한 반도.

blocks.html: Samhan has been split into Three Kingdoms for centuries. However, there remained a hope in the hearts of the common folk, that someday a new King for All would emerge and unite the people.
blocks.ko: 삼한은 수백 년째 세 나라로 갈라져 있다. 그러나 백성의 마음속에는 희망 하나가 남아 있었다. 언젠가 새로운 모두의 왕이 나타나 사람들을 하나로 묶으리라는.

blocks.html: And... perhaps by fate? A new generation arises to meet the age.
blocks.ko: 그리고… 운명이었을까? 새로운 세대가 그 시대를 맞으러 일어선다.

blocks.html: Love.
blocks.ko: 사랑.

blocks.html: Revenge.
blocks.ko: 복수.

blocks.html: Betrayal.
blocks.ko: 배신.

blocks.html: Greed.
blocks.ko: 탐욕.

blocks.html: Loyalty.
blocks.ko: 충성.

blocks.html: Pride.
blocks.ko: 긍지.

blocks.html: Rage.
blocks.ko: 분노.

blocks.html: This is the story of every emotion humans can feel, encapsulated like never before.
blocks.ko: 이것은 인간이 느낄 수 있는 모든 감정의 이야기다. 일찍이 없던 방식으로 담아낸.

blocks.html: This is the story we’ve all heard of before, but never quite like this.
blocks.ko: 우리 모두 한 번쯤 들어 본 이야기. 그러나 이런 이야기는 처음일 것이다.

blocks.html: This is the story to crown the new leader to lead the people out from the darkness..
blocks.ko: 어둠 속에서 백성을 이끌어 낼 새 지도자에게 왕관을 씌우는 이야기..

blocks.html: The King for All!
blocks.ko: 삼한왕검!

images.prompt: HEEWON STYLE MOVIE POSTER key art, 2:1 letterbox, composed so nothing important touches the top or bottom edge; crowns, antlers, wings and heads stay well inside the central band; no title, no lettering. Night of the coronation above the giwa roofs of Seorabeol, a vast starry sky torn by splashed-ink cloud. Low angle from the palace yard stones. INTERACTION: the wingless white heavenly horse Chunma has come down out of the sky and lowers its long arched neck to her; Queen Sunduk, in her gold Silla tree-and-antler crown with jade comma pendants (the real Silla gold crown — upright tree-shaped prongs and antler prongs, not a fantasy orb or crescent), coral-red and white royal silk, reaches up and lays her open palm flat on its forehead, her chin lifted, a small fierce smile; its forelock falls across her fingers and its breath stirs her veil-pendants. Its hind legs still trail in curling cloud streamers above the roofline. CHUNMA HAS NO WINGS: a wingless white heavenly horse, bare white back and shoulders, nothing feathered anywhere; it rides the air on curling cloud-and-flame streamers trailing from its legs. One warm torch key (#E8552B) from the lower left catches her crown, cheek and the horse’s muzzle; the rest is indigo night and ink. Dark eaves in the near foreground. STYLE: HEEWON STYLE, more painterly, with hints of Korean ink painting — Korean webtoon figures (clean ink linework, simplified expressive faces matching the attached portrait, watercolor-washed) inside a hand-painted world of watercolor and oil with traditional sumukhwa ink: splashed-ink storm clouds, bold dry calligraphic brush strokes in manes, fur, feathers, robes and grass, ink bleeding into wet wash, small ink splatters and drips near the frame edges, patches of bare rice paper where the edges dissolve; oil glazes only deepen the darks, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. Movie-poster key art: bold iconic silhouette, the two subjects large and close, one dramatic low angle, one bright break of light behind them, big dark masses, few hues plus one accent, film-poster drama but NO text, NO title, NO credits, NO logo, NO seal stamp. Not photoreal, not 3D. No glow aura, no halo, no emissive outline — the accent colour is real light. One of each named person. No watermark. CANON — QUEEN SUNDUK — FACE and garments from attached /ch_sunduk.png (face only; invent a new pose). Hair ornament matches attached /bn_sunduk.png when the head is visible. Look: Pale oval face, dark calm eyes; black hair in a full coiled updo; when crowned, the gold Silla tree-and-antler crown hung with jade gogok. Dress: Crimson court robe with gold phoenix brocade, blue embroidered cape-collar, a red ribbon bow at the chest. Demeanor: Composed, faint smile, wit in the eyes; looks up at the sky (Cheomseongdae). Never weepy, never cowed. #E8552B as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: Tang empress costume; fantasy tiara in place of the Silla gold crown. | CHUNMA (천마, hyukgose's heavenly horse, guardian of Silla) — attached board /obj_chunma.png: WINGLESS white heavenly horse in the Cheonmachong saddle-flap style: long arched neck, streaming white mane and tail, legs flung out in a flying gallop. It has NO WINGS — no feathers, no bird wings, nothing growing from the shoulders. It rides the sky on curling cloud-and-flame streamers trailing from its legs and chest, as on the painted birch-bark flap. Divine render: numinous through scale and atmosphere, never a glow outline. Kneels and cries beside the purple egg at Najeong, sees men approach, neighs and rises into the sky. | PLACE Surabol (서라벌 (경주)) — attached board /pl_eastern_palace.png; keep this exact architecture and ground. Seorabeol palace: Silla giwa halls, packed-earth yards, timber verandas. | HORSE ANATOMY is a centrepiece: the whole horse body reads clearly and beautifully — arched neck, deep chest, sloping shoulder, round haunch, clean long legs in a correct gait, every muscle modelled by the one hard key with a bright edge along the topline and deep shadow under the belly; the horse is never cropped into a blob, never hidden behind dust, never stiff like a toy; mane and tail as flowing painted strokes; the coat colour exactly as the board. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, shaded in soft watercolor washes and translucent oil glazes instead of flat cel fill — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, not 3D. THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS are a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST room (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt) painted in that same wash-and-glaze: a warm umber-to-black ground, walls, timber, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft with soft sfumato falloff — the webtoon figures are set INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. LIGHT is movie tenebrism: big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. Form is modelled: the key wraps around cheekbones, armor plates, horse muscle and silk folds, then falls off at a hard terminator; a thin edge of that same real light grazes the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — a lit figure against a background pushed two steps darker, or a near-black silhouette against the one bright break; foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. Behind and above the throne, a line of ANCESTRAL SPIRITS of the previous rulers of this kingdom stands in a single receding diagonal row from the upper right down toward the throne, shoulder to shoulder, each crowned and robed, all looking down at the new head: pale and translucent, painted in thin mist-white and grey washes so the hall shows through them, solemn, one of them very slightly bowing. No glow outline, no halo: they are faint like breath on cold air. Below, the court face-down on the floor as dark shapes. Queen Sunduk is the new monarch; the spirits, nearest first, are King Jinpyung, King Jinji and King Jinhung. REFERENCE SHEET. TOP ROW, left to right: LEFT face = sunduk, SECOND face = jinpyung (an ancestral spirit in the frame), THIRD face = jinji (an ancestral spirit in the frame), FOURTH face = jinheung (an ancestral spirit in the frame). Copy each face exactly; give each person the dress the scene names. SMALLER SECOND ROW, left to right: place board pl_moon_palace (keep this exact architecture and ground), costume chart (cut and shape only; ignore its labels, poses and faces), jougwan feather-cap board (shape only, ignore labels), binyeo board sunduk (her hair ornament exactly; not clothing), crown reference (shape only). QUEEN SUNDUK — Look: Pale oval face, dark calm eyes; black hair in a full coiled updo; when crowned, the gold Silla tree-and-antler crown hung with jade gogok. Dress: Crimson court robe with gold phoenix brocade, blue embroidered cape-collar, a red ribbon bow at the chest. Crown: Silla gold crown exactly as the attached museum photo (Cheonmachong / Hwangnamdaechong, 27 to 36 cm tall, as tall again as the face): an OPEN crown with no cap or lining, the hair and topknot showing through it. A NARROW flat gold headband (about a thumb wide) sits level on the forehead. Rising from it, THREE flat sheet-gold tree uprights, one at the centre front and one over each ear: each is a straight vertical stem whose short straight side-branches turn UP at right angles in three or four stacked tiers (like 出), every tip a small bud or heart. At the BACK, two shorter flat antler-shaped uprights angle outward with alternating branches, seen behind the tree uprights, never curling out like horns at the sides. Every upright and the band is hung on fine gold wires with hundreds of small round trembling gold spangles and many curved pale-green jade gogok. From the band at each temple, a long pendant chain of gold leaf-shapes falls past the cheek to the collarbone. Thin, bright, pale gold-silver sheet that trembles and catches light. NEVER a solid basket, never a castle battlement or fence, never horns or deer antlers curving at the sides, never a cap inside, never a European spiked crown or tiara. Colour #E8552B. KING JINPYUNG — Crown: Silla gold crown exactly as the attached museum photo (Cheonmachong / Hwangnamdaechong, 27 to 36 cm tall, as tall again as the face): an OPEN crown with no cap or lining, the hair and topknot showing through it. From the band at each temple, a long pendant chain of gold leaf-shapes falls past the cheek to the collarbone. Thin, bright, pale gold-silver sheet that trembles and catches light. NEVER a solid basket, never a castle battlement or fence, never horns or deer antlers curving at the sides, never a cap inside, never a European spiked crown or tiara. Colour #2f6fd4. PLACE Moon Palace (월궁) — attached board /pl_moon_palace.png; keep this exact architecture and ground. BACKGROUND AND LIGHT (painterly tenebrism): the background IS the place and the moment of the scene — open sky if they are in the sky, the hall if they are in a hall, the gate, the river, the snow — painted loosely in atmospheric brushwork (drifting smoke, cloud, haze, mist, falling snow, embers) in the scene's own colours, soft and out of focus, with a faint bokeh of small lights; it has colour, weather and depth — never a flat black void, never a detailed set; crowds and armies only as massed painted shapes dissolving into haze. ONE hard directional key light that belongs to the place (a brazier, a lamp, the sun through cloud, a torch, moonlight) rakes across the faces and clothes from the side or from below, modelling them in high contrast with deep painted shadows and a thin edge of the same light along the silhouette. Each character's colour lives in that light and in the atmosphere around them — never a glow aura or halo. Faces and bodies act the beat: real expressions, real weight, mid-motion. Faces from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. Each named person appears once, never cloned. Everyone wears period clothing of their own court (Korean, Tang, Yamato, Mohe furs), never European dress. No text, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark. DAY GROUND: the frame is built on WHITE — a high-key, paper-white ground: pale bright sky, white haze and mist, sunlit plaster and pale stone dissolving into bare white paper at the edges, the shadows few, crisp and cool-grey; the figure is the dark, inked thing in a bright frame. Never a black void, never a dim dusk wash.

blocks.html: A Queen? Ridiculous.
blocks.ko: 여왕? 웃기지도 않는군.

blocks.caption: Three kingdoms, one peninsula, and nobody happy with the lines.
blocks.ko: 세 나라, 한 반도, 그리고 그 선에 만족하는 이는 아무도 없다.

blocks.html: Everyone here knows exactly how high they were born.
blocks.ko: 여기선 다들 자기가 얼마나 높이 태어났는지 정확히 안다.

blocks.label: The Lost Girl
blocks.ko: 사라진 아이

blocks.label: Munhee’s Room
blocks.ko: 문희의 방

blocks.html: Somebody says it in the corridor, not quite quietly enough. Across the palace, Yushin’s little sister is getting ready too. Munhee is getting her hair done for tomorrow’s coronation, and four maids are doing the hair and the gossip at the same time.
blocks.ko: 누군가 복도에서 그 말을 한다. 충분히 작은 목소리는 아니다. 궁 건너편에서는 유신의 누이도 채비 중이다. 문희는 내일 즉위식에 맞춰 머리를 하는 중이고, 몸종 넷이 머리와 소문을 한꺼번에 만지고 있다.

blocks.caption: Twenty-six, sharp-tongued, and married to the wrong man on purpose.
blocks.ko: 스물여섯, 입이 매섭고, 일부러 엉뚱한 남자에게 시집간 여자.

en: Did you hear? A queen. Silla’s getting a queen.
Shh— not so loud.
Why not? There are no men left. Not the right bone, anyway.
lines: 와? 남자가 없다 아이가. 뼈 맞는 남자는.

blocks.html: The old king is dead, and in Silla only Sacred Bone may wear the crown. The Sacred Bone men have run out. What is left is women: Dukman, her older sister, and a cousin named Sungman who is very glad it isn’t her.
blocks.ko: 선왕이 승하했다. 신라에서 왕관은 성골만 쓸 수 있다. 그런데 성골 사내가 바닥났다. 남은 건 여자들이다. 덕만, 그 언니, 그리고 그게 제가 아니라서 몹시 다행인 사촌 승만.

blocks.title: The royal house · 신라 왕실
blocks.caption: Gold rings are Sacred Bone, purple are True Bone. The men in gold have run out. Dukman, her sister Chunmyung and their cousin Seungman are what is left.
blocks.ko: 금빛 테두리는 성골, 보랏빛은 진골. 금빛 사내들은 다 떨어졌다. 남은 건 덕만, 언니 천명, 사촌 승만이다.

en: Ridiculous, is it. Mm.
Whoever said that, tell him he can come in here and say it to my face. I’ll be done in a minute.
lines: 그 말 한 양반, 들어와서 내 얼굴 보고 다시 해 보라 캐라. 금방 끝난다.

blocks.html: A page holds up a hairpin. It is the wrong one.
blocks.ko: 시동이 비녀 하나를 받쳐 든다. 엉뚱한 비녀다.

lines: 귀족 여인에게 영 어울리지 않는구나… 얘야, 더 나은 걸 못 찾겠니?
en: Totally unfit for a Noble woman… Come on, boy, can’t you find something better?

blocks.html: Then all four maids stop breathing at once. The door has opened, and the most popular man in Silla is standing in it.
blocks.ko: 그때 몸종 넷이 한꺼번에 숨을 멈춘다. 문이 열렸고, 신라에서 가장 인기 있는 사내가 거기 서 있다.

blocks.html: Kim Yushin is thirty-seven. He runs the Hwarang yard: horse, bow, gyuku, the place boys learn whether they matter. People call him the Sword of Silla. The women of the capital rank him a close third, behind Chunchu and a young swordsman called Bidam, and they argue about the order at every well.
blocks.ko: 김유신, 서른일곱. 화랑의 연무장을 맡고 있다. 말, 활, 격구. 소년들은 거기서 제가 중요한 사람인지 배운다. 사람들은 그를 신라의 도검이라 부른다. 도성 여인들 사이에서는 춘추와 비담이라는 젊은 검객 다음, 아슬아슬한 셋째다. 그 순서를 두고 우물가마다 말다툼이 난다.

blocks.caption: Thirty-seven. Gaya blood, Silla rank, and the yard is his.
blocks.ko: 서른일곱. 가야의 피, 신라의 품계, 그리고 마당은 그의 것.

en: The marshal—
He came in. He came IN.
Don’t look.
…I’m looking.
If he smiles, I’m fainting. I mean it.
lines: 한 번만 웃으시믄 내 기절한데이. 진짜다.

en: Out. All of you— no, not you, you’re holding my hair.
Orabuni. Knock. You’re a general, not the weather.
lines: 다 나가라. — 니 말고, 니는 내 머리 잡고 있제.
오라버니, 문 좀 두드려라. 장군이지, 날씨가?

en: The coronation things. The Princess asked me to see they’re ready.
lines: 즉위식 물건들. 공주님께서 다 갖춰졌는지 보라 하셨다.

en: Ready. Robes, pressed. Belt, the jade one. Shoes, gilt, both feet. Seals in the box. Incense, enough to smoke out Baekje.
And the crown is—
lines: 다 됐다. 옷, 다렸고. 띠, 옥띠. 신, 금동, 두 짝 다. 인장은 함에. 향은 백제까지 연기 피울 만큼.

blocks.html: The crown stand is empty. Somebody has left a very neat dent in the silk.
blocks.ko: 왕관 받침이 비어 있다. 누군가 비단 위에 아주 반듯한 자국만 남겨 두었다.

en: Ah— my lady. Lord Chunchu took it this morning. For… preparation, he said.
And he took the two older ones with him.
lines: 아— 마님. 춘추 공께서 아침에 가져가셨어예. 준비하신다꼬…
그라고 큰 아기씨 둘도 데리고 가셨어예.

blocks.html: In the corner, little Inmun rocks in his cradle and says nothing, which is the only alibi in the room.
blocks.ko: 구석에서는 어린 인문이 요람에서 흔들리며 아무 말도 하지 않는다. 방 안에서 유일하게 알리바이가 있는 사람이다.

en: CHUNCHU!!!

blocks.html: The pigeons leave the roof. Somewhere far out in the fields, a man on a horse feels his ears go hot.
blocks.ko: 지붕의 비둘기들이 날아오른다. 멀리 들판 어딘가에서, 말 탄 사내 하나가 귀가 화끈해지는 걸 느낀다.

blocks.label: The Shore
blocks.ko: 바닷가

blocks.html: Her husband Chunchu is twenty-nine, and already the most cunning man in Samhan. Today he has used it to steal a crown from his wife.
blocks.ko: 남편 춘추는 스물아홉, 벌써 삼한에서 가장 교활한 사내다. 오늘 그 재주로 아내 방에서 왕관을 훔쳐 냈다.

blocks.caption: Spring and autumn. Also the name of the oldest chronicle Confucius ever edited. He means to be in the next one.
blocks.ko: 봄과 가을. 공자가 엮은 가장 오래된 역사책의 이름이기도 하다. 그는 다음 역사책에 들어갈 작정이다.

blocks.html: Splendid in looks and bearing.
blocks.ko: 풍채가 영특하고 훌륭하였다.
blocks.hanja: 儀表英偉
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals

blocks.html: They saw how splendid Chunchu was in looks and bearing.
blocks.ko: 춘추의 풍채가 영특하고 훌륭한 것을 보았다.
blocks.hanja: 見春秋儀表英偉
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals

blocks.html: Chunchu was handsome.
blocks.ko: 춘추는 용모가 아름다웠다.
blocks.hanja: 春秋美姿顏
blocks.source: Nihon Shoki (日本書紀) bk. 25

blocks.html: Gotaso sits in front of him on the same horse. Bupmin, six, has his own, and will not share the saddle.
blocks.ko: 고타소는 아버지와 같은 말 안장 앞자리에 앉는다. 여섯 살 법민은 제 말이 있고, 안장을 나눠 타지 않는다.

blocks.caption: Chunchu’s daughter. Whatever it is, she wants it faster.
blocks.ko: 춘추의 딸. 무엇이든 더 빨리 가길 원한다.

en: Faster.
Father. Faster.
You'll bite your tongue.
Then you'll talk less, which — wait, that's the joke? Right. Hold on.
lines: 그라믄 말이 줄겠제 — 잠깐, 그기 농담이가? 됐다. 잡아라.

blocks.caption: Six years old, and already drafting laws for the people with no bones.
blocks.ko: 여섯 살. 벌써 뼈 없는 사람들을 위한 법을 짜고 있다.

en: I'm not racing.
I'm following. That's different.
That's a lawyer's horse, son.
Look at you. I shall have to tell your mother you invented a new kind of slow.
lines: 봐라. 니 어머니한테 니가 느린 걸 새로 발명했다 캐야겠다.

blocks.html: They cross an open field at a gallop and do not stop until the grass turns to sand. The eastern sea lies flat and silver. Somewhere past it are the pirates.
blocks.ko: 그들은 탁 트인 들판을 내달려, 풀이 모래로 바뀌어서야 멈춘다. 동해가 은빛으로 납작하게 누워 있다. 그 너머 어딘가에 해적들이 있다.

en: Great-great-great-grandfather beat the pirates right here! They came in boats and he sent them home with no boats!
And then— and then Great-great-grandfather took the whole river off Baekje AND Goguryeo. Both. At the same time.
lines: 고조할배의 할배가 여기서 해적들 다 이겼다! 배 타고 왔는데 배 없이 돌려보냈다!
그라고— 그라고 고조할배는 강을 통째로 백제한테서도 고구려한테서도 뺏았다. 둘 다. 한꺼번에.
그리고요, 어젯밤에 꿈을 꿨는데 도깨비가 나왔어요. 엄청 많이요. 발이 없는데 깜깜한 데서 다리를 놨어요.
그리고 하나는 여우였는데요, 할아버지한테 절을 하더니—
en: And last night I had a dream with goblins in it. Loads. They had no feet and they built a bridge in the dark.
And one of them was a fox, and he bowed to Grandfather, and he said—

lines: 그러다 너도 개울이랑 얘기하면, 네 어미가 널 어디다 두겠니?
en: Bupmin. Stop listening to your grandfather.
Next you’ll be talking to the stream, and then where will your mother put you?
…He said it was an honour.
I’m sure he did. Foxes are very polite.
When I’m king everyone has to listen to me.
Even the bone people.
…And the ones with no bone. Those most, there’s more of them.
lines: 내 임금 되면 다들 내 말 들어야 된데이.
…뼈 없는 사람들도. 그 사람들이 더 많으니까네 더 들어야 된다.

en: I’m going to be the King for All. The Wanggum. Everybody’s been fighting forever, and I’m going to make them one again.
lines: 내는 왕검 될 끼다. 모두의 임금. 다들 천날만날 싸우기만 하는데, 내가 다시 하나로 만들 끼다.

blocks.html: Chunchu laughs, the real one, the one the court never gets. He will keep an eye on that sea for a long time, this boy. Nobody on the beach knows how long.
blocks.ko: 춘추가 웃는다. 진짜 웃음, 조정은 한 번도 들어 본 적 없는 웃음이다. 이 아이는 저 바다를 오래도록 지켜볼 것이다. 얼마나 오래일지, 해변의 누구도 모른다.

en: King for All. Ha! Then you’ll need a bigger horse, son.
lines: 모두의 임금이라. 하! 그라믄 말부터 큰 걸로 바꿔야겠다, 아들아.

en: …Keep that.
I may need to borrow it back when I am braver.
lines: 내가 더 용감해지믄 다시 빌릴지도 모르고.

blocks.html: Then he reaches into the saddlebag and unwraps something the size of a cooking pot. The gold leaves on it start shivering before it is even out of the cloth.
blocks.ko: 그러고는 안장 주머니에 손을 넣어, 솥만 한 무언가를 풀어 낸다. 천에서 다 나오기도 전에 그 위의 금 잎들이 떨기 시작한다.

en: Don’t tell your mother. Officially, this is still on its stand.
Go on. Look. Not touch. Look.
lines: 어머니한테는 말하지 마래이. 공식적으로 이건 아직 받침 위에 있다.

en: …It’s shaking. All the little gold leaves. It’s—
Can I wear it?
No.

blocks.html: Then Chunchu feels a shiver climb his spine, the way a deer does a moment before the arrow. On the dune above them stands Kim Yushin, and he is not smiling.
blocks.ko: 그때 춘추의 등골을 타고 소름이 오른다. 화살이 오기 직전의 사슴처럼. 그들 위 모래 언덕에 김유신이 서 있다. 웃고 있지 않다.

blocks.html: He comes down the sand in four strides and hooks an arm around Chunchu’s neck.
blocks.ko: 그는 모래 언덕을 네 걸음에 내려와 춘추의 목에 팔을 건다.

en: Who do you think you are, that you can lie to the sister of Kim Yushin like that?
lines: 자네가 뭐라고, 감히 김유신의 누이를 그렇게 속이나?

en: Agh— brother-in-law— don’t forget, I might be Munhee’s husband, but I’m also the nephew of the new queen—!
lines: 아악— 처남— 잊지 마소, 내가 문희 남편이기도 하지만, 새 여왕의 조카이기도 하다는 거—!

en: I’m not here as a general. I’m here as Munhee’s brother, goddammit.
I could probably throw you into the ocean right now and no one would know.
Bupmin, Gotaso, close your eyes.
lines: 장군으로 온 게 아닐세. 문희 오라비로 왔네, 이 빌어먹을.
지금 자네를 저 바다에 던져도 아무도 모를 걸세.

en: Agh— but with me gone, who’s going to send all of your messages to the new queen?
Secret meetings with the princess is one thing, but a queen? You’d need family privileges for that.
lines: 아악— 근데 내가 없으믄, 새 여왕한테 처남 편지는 누가 전하노?
공주님하고 몰래 만나는 거야 그렇다 쳐도, 여왕? 그건 집안사람 특권이 있어야 될 낀데.

en: Y-you wouldn’t dare— (blushing)
Try me~~ (smirking)
That was dirty. (lets go)

blocks.html: He holds out a fist.
blocks.ko: 그가 주먹을 내민다.

en: You’ve got to let her go, man. Everyone in the kingdom knows at this point.
lines: 이제 놔줘야 된다, 처남. 온 나라가 다 안다 아이가.

blocks.html: Chunchu knocks it with his own, the way they have since they were nine.
blocks.ko: 춘추가 제 주먹으로 맞부딪친다. 아홉 살 때부터 그래 왔듯이.

blocks.html: Hahahahaha!
blocks.ko: 하하하하하!

en: Uncle Yushin!! You’re back!
You’re back!
Good to see you again, dude.
Haha… I didn’t know you were back after your latest campaign. How’d that go?
lines: 하하… 이번 원정에서 돌아온 줄 몰랐네. 우째 됐노?

en: You know how these things go… fought them for a bit, classic fake retreat, they followed us to a valley, then BOOM! Ambush.
I have no idea how they keep falling for that one.
lines: 늘 하던 대로지… 좀 싸우다가, 거짓으로 물러나고, 놈들이 골짜기까지 따라오고, 그러다 쾅! 매복.
어째서 놈들이 그걸 매번 속는지 모르겠네.

blocks.html: Bupmin has forgotten to breathe.
blocks.ko: 법민은 숨 쉬는 것도 잊었다.

en: I bet the battle was over as soon as they heard your name.
lines: 장담컨대 자네 이름 듣자마자 싸움은 끝났을 걸세.

en: Always.
Anyways, I heard you were gonna be the King for All, eh? You’re gonna need to be big and strong for that.
En garde!
lines: 그건 그렇고, 네가 모두의 임금이 된다며? 그러려면 크고 튼튼해야 한다.

blocks.html: He tosses the boy a stick of driftwood and takes one for himself.
blocks.ko: 그는 소년에게 유목 막대 하나를 던져 주고 자기도 하나 집어 든다.

en: Hey, if there’s anyone that’s qualified to be the King for All, it’s your dad right here.
lines: 그래도 말이다, 모두의 임금 될 자격이 있는 사람이 있다면, 바로 여기 네 아버지다.

en: Me? I like books, and wine, and your mother when she isn’t shouting. Politics is for men with smaller lives.
But you, son. You chase it. All the way.
lines: 내가? 내는 책 좋고, 술 좋고, 안 소리 지를 때의 니 어머니가 좋다. 정치는 삶이 쪼매난 사내들이나 하는 기다.
근데 니는, 아들아. 니는 쫓아가라. 끝까지.

en: Uncle, do you have a dream?
Mine? Just to protect the country. That’s all.
lines: 내 꿈? 그냥 나라를 지키는 거다. 그게 다야.

blocks.html: He says it lightly. Something underneath it is not light at all.
blocks.ko: 그는 가볍게 말한다. 그 밑의 무언가는 전혀 가볍지 않다.

en: Why don’t you go after your highest dreams?
lines: 그라믄 제일 높은 꿈은 와 안 쫓아가예?

blocks.html: Yushin does not answer. He lets the boy hit him with the stick instead.
blocks.ko: 유신은 대답하지 않는다. 대신 소년의 막대에 한 대 맞아 준다.

blocks.html: Chunchu looks back at the hills. He made a country up there once, with Yushin, when he was nine and the stars were still negotiable. Neither of them tells it the same way twice.
blocks.ko: 춘추가 뒤의 언덕들을 돌아본다. 저기서 한번 나라를 만든 적이 있다. 유신과 함께, 아홉 살이었고 별도 아직 흥정이 되던 시절이었다. 둘 다 그 이야기를 할 때마다 조금씩 다르게 한다.

blocks.html: Two boys on a hill above Surabol, lying on their backs, arguing about the sky.
blocks.ko: 서라벌이 내려다보이는 언덕. 두 소년이 드러누워 하늘을 두고 다투고 있다.

en: Brother. That star, in the east.
That one’s the brightest, isn’t it?

lines: 그건 별이 아이라 행성이다, 이 녀석아.
en: That is a planet, not a star, you idiot.

lines: 그럼 더 좋지요. 별들 사이에 섞여 있으면서 별이 아니잖습니까.
en: Even better. It sits among the stars without being one of them.
Just like you.

lines: 고려도, 백제도, 신라도 없이. 그냥… 사람들만.
그리고 그 위에, 모두를 위한 임금 하나.
en: Brother. Let us make Samhan one country.
No Goguryeo, no Baekje, no Silla. Just… people.
And over them, one king for all of them.
“A king for all.”
…You be that. I will stand beside you.
That is a promise, then.

blocks.html: The sun gets low. The boys are still fencing with driftwood. Chunchu turns round to count his children and gets to one.
blocks.ko: 해가 기운다. 사내들은 아직도 유목 막대로 칼싸움 중이다. 춘추가 돌아서서 아이들을 센다. 하나에서 멈춘다.

blocks.html: Gotaso’s horse is standing on the sand with an empty saddle.
blocks.ko: 고타소의 말이 빈 안장을 얹은 채 모래 위에 서 있다.

blocks.label: The Search
blocks.ko: 수색

blocks.html: By dark, half the garrison of Surabol is out in the hills with torches, looking for one seven-year-old girl. Chunchu rides at the front. He is not making jokes.
blocks.ko: 어둠이 내릴 무렵, 서라벌 군사 절반이 횃불을 들고 산을 뒤진다. 일곱 살 여자아이 하나를 찾느라. 춘추가 맨 앞에서 말을 몬다. 농담은 하지 않는다.

blocks.html: Bupmin rides at the back with a cloth bundle in his lap that he will not hand to anyone. Nobody has thought to ask what is in it.
blocks.ko: 법민은 맨 뒤에서, 누구에게도 내주지 않는 보따리 하나를 무릎에 얹고 간다. 그 안에 뭐가 들었는지 묻는 사람은 아무도 없다.

en: Is that Lord Chunchu? I’ve never seen him like this.
He laughs at funerals. I’ve seen him do it.
lines: 저기 춘추 공 맞나? 저런 얼굴은 처음 본다.
장례식에서도 웃는 양반인데. 내가 봤다 카이.

en: You’re too young to understand.
Never underestimate the power… of a scorned father….!
lines: 절대로 얕보지 마래이… 성난 아버지의… 힘을….!

blocks.label: The Dokkebi
blocks.ko: 도깨비

blocks.html: He finds her at the top of a ridge, under a pine that should not be able to hold what is sitting in it. Something in a mask has Gotaso by the collar.
blocks.ko: 그는 능선 꼭대기에서 딸을 찾는다. 소나무 한 그루 아래, 그 나무가 버틸 수 없어야 할 무언가가 가지에 앉아 있다. 탈을 쓴 무언가가 고타소의 옷깃을 쥐고 있다.

blocks.html: A dokkaebi. It grins through its mask, which is a trick, because the mask is already grinning.
blocks.ko: 도깨비다. 탈 너머로 히죽 웃는다. 재주도 좋다. 탈이 이미 웃고 있는데.

blocks.html: Chunchu does not shout. He draws. Steel rings on something that is not steel, twice, three times, and the thing laughs and leaps straight up into the dark with the girl under its arm.
blocks.ko: 춘추는 소리치지 않는다. 칼을 뽑는다. 강철이 강철 아닌 것에 부딪쳐 울린다. 두 번, 세 번. 그것이 웃더니 아이를 옆구리에 낀 채 어둠 속으로 곧장 솟구친다.

blocks.html: Chunchu jumps after it, misses with both hands, and catches the hem of its coat in his teeth. Up they go, higher than the pines, the most cunning man in Samhan hanging by his jaw.
blocks.ko: 춘추가 뒤따라 뛰어오른다. 두 손은 허공을 쥐고, 이로 놈의 옷자락을 문다. 그렇게 소나무보다 높이 올라간다. 삼한에서 가장 교활한 사내가 턱 하나로 매달린 채.

blocks.html: The dokkaebi shakes its coat once, and lets the girl go.
blocks.ko: 도깨비가 옷자락을 한 번 털더니, 아이를 놓아 버린다.

blocks.html: Chunchu lets go too. He catches her in the air. Then they are both falling.
blocks.ko: 춘추도 놓는다. 허공에서 딸을 받아 안는다. 그리고 둘 다 떨어진다.

en: Daddy….! We’re falling!
Don’t worry, princess! Because no matter what… if we love each other…. we’ll meet again no matter where we are…!
lines: 걱정 마라, 공주야! 무슨 일이 있어도… 우리가 서로 사랑하믄…. 어디서든 다시 만난다…!

blocks.html: He wraps himself around her, his back to the ground, and the wind knocks the sense out of them both.
blocks.ko: 그는 등을 땅 쪽으로 돌려 딸을 감싸 안는다. 바람이 둘의 정신을 날려 버린다.

blocks.html: The ground does not arrive.
blocks.ko: 땅은 오지 않는다.

blocks.label: The Heavenly Horse
blocks.ko: 천마

blocks.html: Something slows them, like a hand under a falling cup. A white horse with no business in the sky gallops down the air with two Kims across its back and sets them on the grass as gently as laundry.
blocks.ko: 무언가가 그들을 늦춘다. 떨어지는 잔을 받치는 손처럼. 하늘에 있을 이유가 없는 흰 말 한 마리가 김씨 둘을 등에 싣고 허공을 달려 내려와, 빨래 내려놓듯 풀밭에 살며시 내려놓는다.

blocks.html: Down on the ridge, Bupmin has untied his bundle. The gold crown sits on his small head, far too big for it, every leaf shaking. His hands are raised, and the horse in the sky is following them. His pupils have gone white.
blocks.ko: 능선 아래에서 법민이 보따리를 풀었다. 금관이 작은 머리에 얹혀 있다. 한참 크다. 잎마다 떤다. 아이의 두 손이 올라가 있고, 하늘의 말은 그 손을 따라온다. 눈동자가 하얗게 질렸다.

blocks.html: Then the crown starts to shake him back. It was not made for his bone, and it knows. His knees go.
blocks.ko: 그러다 왕관이 아이를 거꾸로 흔들기 시작한다. 그의 뼈를 위해 만든 관이 아니고, 관도 그걸 안다. 무릎이 꺾인다.

blocks.html: A hooded figure catches him before he hits the grass, lifts the crown off his head and sets it on her own. The horse calms at once, like a dog that has heard its name, and walks the last of the sky down to the ground.
blocks.ko: 두건 쓴 이가 아이가 풀밭에 닿기 전에 받아 안는다. 아이 머리에서 왕관을 들어 제 머리에 얹는다. 말이 이름을 들은 개처럼 단번에 잠잠해져, 남은 하늘을 걸어 땅으로 내려온다.

blocks.html: The hood comes back. It is Princess Dukman. Behind her, breathing hard, is Yushin.
blocks.ko: 두건이 젖혀진다. 덕만공주다. 그 뒤에 숨을 몰아쉬는 유신이 있다.

blocks.html: So the first time the crown sits on Dukman’s head, the council has not even voted. Back in the palace, six men are lighting a brazier to argue about her. Let’s not tell them.
blocks.ko: 그러니 덕만이 처음 왕관을 쓴 건, 화백이 표결도 하기 전이다. 궁에서는 지금 여섯 사내가 그녀를 두고 다투려고 화로에 불을 붙이는 중이다. 그들에겐 말하지 말자.

en: Did you see the boy? Six years old, and the horse came to him.
lines: 그 아이 보셨습니까? 여섯 살인데, 말이 그 아이한테 왔습니다.

en: It came. It didn’t stay. Give him twenty years.
lines: 오기는 왔제. 머물지는 않았고. 스무 해만 주게.

en: And his father.
Chunchu would make a fine king. If he could stop counting his children long enough to count anything else.
lines: 춘추는 좋은 임금이 될 걸세. 제 아이들 세는 걸 잠깐만 멈추고 다른 걸 셀 수만 있다면.

en: He’d say that’s the point, Princess.
lines: 그 사람은 그게 요점이라 하겠지요, 공주님.

blocks.html: She laughs. Then neither of them says anything for a while.
blocks.ko: 그녀가 웃는다. 그러고는 한동안 둘 다 말이 없다.

en: …Once.
Once what.
Call me by name, not by title. / Today, since it is the last day for it.
lines: 직함 말고, 이름으로. / 오늘이 마지막일 테니.

en: …Yushin-ah.

blocks.html: Nobody on the ridge hears it. She will not say it again until a night of small rain, years from now. He will still hear it on the day he dies.
blocks.ko: 능선의 누구도 듣지 못한다. 그녀는 여러 해 뒤, 가랑비 내리는 어느 밤까지 다시는 그 이름을 부르지 않는다. 그는 죽는 날에도 그 소리를 들을 것이다.

blocks.html: Then they both look away at the same moment, and both become very interested in the horse.
blocks.ko: 그러고는 둘이 같은 순간에 고개를 돌리고, 둘 다 갑자기 말에 몹시 관심이 많아진다.

blocks.html: On the walk back, Yushin keeps hearing a six-year-old. Why don’t you go after your highest dreams? His highest dream is walking two steps ahead of him, wearing a crown that is not hers yet.
blocks.ko: 돌아오는 길 내내, 유신의 귀에 여섯 살짜리 목소리가 맴돈다. 그라믄 제일 높은 꿈은 와 안 쫓아가예? 그의 가장 높은 꿈은 두 걸음 앞에서 걷고 있다. 아직은 제 것이 아닌 왕관을 쓰고.

blocks.html: At the palace gate he leaves her. The Council has asked its Marshal to stand by the wall tonight and answer questions, and he is already late.
blocks.ko: 궁문에서 그는 그녀와 헤어진다. 화백이 오늘 밤 도검에게 벽 곁에 서서 물음에 답하라 했고, 그는 벌써 늦었다.

blocks.label: Coronation
blocks.ko: 즉위

blocks.label: Coronation Morning
blocks.ko: 즉위식 아침

blocks.html: In the hall the sleeves are the census. Purple at the front for True Bone, then scarlet, blue and yellow, down to the doors. You can read a man before he speaks.
blocks.ko: 전각에서는 소매가 호적이다. 앞줄은 진골의 자주색, 그 뒤로 붉은색, 푸른색, 노란색이 문까지 이어진다. 입을 열기 전에 사람을 읽는다.

blocks.html: Past the yellow there is no colour at all. The men holding the canopy poles wear undyed hemp. Nobody counts them.
blocks.ko: 노란색 너머엔 아무 색도 없다. 일산 장대를 든 사내들은 물들이지 않은 삼베를 입었다. 아무도 그들을 세지 않는다.

blocks.html: A priest walks at her elbow, murmuring the order of the rite from under a deep hood. He has a sword callus on his right hand. Dukman looks twice.
blocks.ko: 사제 하나가 깊은 두건 아래에서 의식의 순서를 읊조리며 그녀 곁을 걷는다. 오른손에 칼 굳은살이 있다. 덕만이 두 번 쳐다본다.

en: …Lord Yushin?
The priest has a cold, Princess. I offered.
lines: 사제가 고뿔에 걸렸습니다, 공주님. 제가 자청했습니다.

blocks.html: On the way in, an old man in a corridor says it again, not quite quietly enough.
blocks.ko: 들어오는 길, 복도에서 한 노인이 또 그 말을 한다. 충분히 작은 목소리는 아니다.

en: You heard him.
I put on this confident face, but honestly — me, a king…
I’ll do it no matter what. I just don’t know if I can.
lines: 난 이렇게 당당한 척은 하지만, 솔직히… 내가 왕이라니.
무슨 일이 있어도 할 걸세. 다만 해낼 수 있을지를 모르겠어.
이 세상에서, 항상 공주님 편인 한 명이라도 있으면 좋지 않겠습니까?
en: Whether you do it well or badly —
that is what “no matter what” means.
In all this world, wouldn’t it be good to have one person always on your side, Princess?
Slaves, Princess. They aren’t in the count.

lines: …사람을 사람 수에 넣지 않는 나라가, 어떻게 천 년을 가겠는가.
en: …A country that does not count people as people. How is that meant to last a thousand years?

blocks.html: Then she walks the length of the hall alone. Two hundred sleeves bow, some of them late.
blocks.ko: 그러고 그녀는 홀로 전각 끝까지 걷는다. 소매 이백 개가 고개를 숙인다. 몇은 늦게.

blocks.html: The crown is carried by the oldest man on the Council. She knows the voice. This morning it said “ridiculous” in her corridor.
blocks.ko: 왕관은 화백에서 가장 나이 많은 사내가 받쳐 든다. 그녀는 그 목소리를 안다. 오늘 아침 복도에서 “웃기지도 않는다”고 한 목소리다.

en: Still ridiculous, my lord?
…Entirely, Majesty.
Hold still. It’s heavier than it looks.
So am I.

blocks.html: He sets it on her head. It fits. It fitted last night too. Nobody mentions it.
blocks.ko: 그가 그녀 머리에 왕관을 얹는다. 꼭 맞는다. 어젯밤에도 맞았다. 아무도 그 얘기는 하지 않는다.

blocks.html: And so she becomes the first Queen of Silla. They will call her Queen Sunduk, the Blue Moon of the Divine Country.
blocks.ko: 그렇게 그녀는 신라의 첫 여왕이 된다. 사람들은 그녀를 선덕여왕, 신국의 푸른 달이라 부를 것이다.

blocks.hanja: 德曼性寬仁明敏。
blocks.html: Dukman was generous and humane by nature, clear-sighted and quick.
blocks.ko: 덕만은 성품이 너그럽고 어질며, 총명하고 민첩하였다.
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals — Queen Seondeok, accession notice

blocks.html: Sun, for kindness.
Duk, for virtue.

blocks.name: Sunduk
blocks.ko: 선덕

blocks.label: The Oaths
blocks.ko: 맹세

blocks.html: Then Silla swears to her, one floor of the house at a time.
blocks.ko: 그러고 신라가 그녀에게 맹세한다. 집의 층마다 한 층씩.

blocks.html: First the Harmony Council, six sleeves in a row, who sat up all night to make this happen and look it.
blocks.ko: 먼저 화백. 소매 여섯이 한 줄로 선다. 이 일을 위해 밤을 새웠고, 얼굴에 다 쓰여 있다.

en: The Council speaks in harmony, Majesty. For once, we mean it.
lines: 화백은 한목소리로 아룁니다, 폐하. 이번만큼은 진심입니다.

blocks.html: Then the young knights kneel. In front kneels the yard’s Second Blade, a cool young man who has never once waited his turn. You’ll meet him properly last night.
blocks.ko: 젊은 화랑들이 무릎을 꿇는다. 맨 앞에는 연무장의 제이검이 있다. 한 번도 제 차례를 기다린 적 없는 서늘한 젊은이다. 그와는 어젯밤에 제대로 인사하게 될 것이다.

lines: 혁거세 성조의 빛에 걸고, 신라의 젊은 화랑들은 여왕 폐하께 영원한 충성을 맹세합니다!
en: By Hyukgosé’s light, we, the young Hwarang knights of Silla, pledge eternal allegiance to the Queen!

blocks.html: Then the family. Her sister Chunmyung, who could have been queen and looks relieved. Her cousin Sungman, who looks even more relieved. Her sister’s husband stands beside her and tells the canopy pole it is doing very well. Chunmyung steps on his foot without looking.
blocks.ko: 그다음은 집안. 여왕이 될 수도 있었고 안도한 얼굴의 언니 천명. 그보다 더 안도한 얼굴의 사촌 승만. 언니의 남편은 옆에 서서 일산대한테 아주 잘하고 있다고 말한다. 천명이 쳐다보지도 않고 그의 발을 밟는다.

en: Your nephew, Majesty, and your servant. These three are yours as well. The loud one most of all.
lines: 폐하의 조카이자 종입니다. 이 셋도 폐하 것입니다. 시끄러운 놈은 특히.

en: Your crown is back on its stand, Majesty. I counted the leaves.
lines: 왕관은 받침에 도로 올려 두었습니다, 폐하. 잎도 다 세어 봤습니다.

en: Is it done? Can we go fast now?
lines: 다 끝났어예? 이제 빨리 가도 돼예?

en: I swear too. Until I’m king. Then we’ll see.
lines: 내도 맹세한다. 내가 임금 될 때까지. 그다음은 두고 보고.

blocks.html: Inmun sneezes. It is taken as an oath.
blocks.ko: 인문이 재채기를 한다. 맹세로 친다.

blocks.html: At the end of the ceremony, everyone chants for their new queen.
blocks.ko: 의식이 끝나고, 모두가 새 여왕을 연호한다.

blocks.html: May the heavenly White Horse bless this queen… Long live the Queen! Long live the Hwarang spirit! Long live Silla!
blocks.ko: 하늘의 백마여 이 여왕을 축복하소서… 여왕 폐하 만세! 화랑의 얼 만세! 신라 만세!

blocks.label: The Kings Above
blocks.ko: 위에서 보는 왕들

blocks.html: That night she dreams the hall is full. The old kings stand along the walls the way their portraits do — Jinheung with his soldier's jaw, Beopheung with his monk's patience, her father with the tired eyes she remembers from the sickbed — and every one of them looks down at her, beaming. She wakes before any of them can speak. The crown sits on its stand in the dark, every leaf still. It fits.
blocks.ko: 그날 밤 꿈에 전각이 가득하다. 옛 왕들이 초상화처럼 벽에 늘어서 있다 — 병사의 턱을 한 진흥, 중의 인내를 한 법흥, 병상에서 기억하는 지친 눈의 아버지 — 모두가 내려다보며 환하게 웃는다. 누가 입을 열기 전에 깬다. 어둠 속 받침 위에 면류관이 앉아 있다, 잎 하나 흔들리지 않고. 맞는다.

blocks.label: The Last Oath
blocks.ko: 마지막 맹세

blocks.html: Later, when the hall is empty, one man stays at the door. He does not kneel to the country, or the yard, or even the crown.
blocks.ko: 나중에, 전각이 비고 나서도 한 사내가 문가에 남는다. 그는 나라에도, 연무장에도, 왕관에조차 무릎 꿇지 않는다.

en: Hwarang Kim Yushin.
I will always be loyal to Princess Dukman.

blocks.html: The Queen of Silla goes red to the ears, and is very glad that nobody counts the doorway.
blocks.ko: 신라의 여왕이 귀까지 빨개진다. 문간은 아무도 세지 않아서 몹시 다행이다.

blocks.label: The Neighbours
blocks.ko: 이웃 나라들

blocks.html: Silla sends envoys to tell the neighbours. The neighbours have opinions.
blocks.ko: 신라는 이웃 나라에 사신을 보내 소식을 알린다. 이웃 나라들에겐 할 말이 있다.

lines: 그 진평이 늙은이가 드디어 죽었다고… 흥! 잘됐군. 그런데 딸을 앉혔다고, 어…?
en: So that old brat Jinpyung is finally dead… Bah! Good riddance. And they have seated a daughter, eh…?

blocks.html: In Pyongyang, a tired king laughs into his wine and bets on how long her council lasts.
blocks.ko: 평양에서는 지친 임금이 술잔에 대고 웃으며, 그 회의가 얼마나 갈지 내기를 건다.

en: A queen in Surabol. Well, well.
Pour me another. And put a jar on it: one season. Two, if her council is patient.
lines: 한 잔 더 따르거라. 그리고 내기를 걸자꾸나. 한 철. 그 화백이 참을성이 있다면 두 철이구나.

blocks.html: Far to the south, on an island that grows oranges and ignores the mainland, a king hears it from a fish trader.
blocks.ko: 멀리 남쪽, 귤이 자라고 뭍에는 관심 없는 섬에서, 한 임금이 생선 장수에게 그 소식을 듣는다.

en: A woman on the throne in Silla, eh? Well. The one who made this island was a woman too.
Sit down, I’ll tell you from the beginning— no. Not today. That one takes all night.
lines: 신라에 여자가 앉았다고? 그래. 이 섬을 만든 이도 여자였지.
앉아 봐라, 처음부터 말하마— 아니, 오늘은 말고. 그 얘긴 밤을 새야 하지.

blocks.html: While Chunchu searched the hills, six men around a brazier argued over a crown that wasn’t even in the room…!
blocks.ko: 춘추가 산을 뒤지던 그 밤, 화로 앞의 사내 여섯은 방에 있지도 않은 왕관을 두고 다투고 있었다…!

logline.en: Six nobles. One brazier. Nobody stands up until they all agree.
logline.ko: 귀족 여섯. 화로 하나. 모두 뜻이 같아질 때까지 아무도 일어서지 않는다.

images.alt: The Coronation of Napoleon as a vast Neoclassical canvas: young Bidam raising the Silla gold crown over Dukman kneeling before him, True Bone elders watching
images.prompt: A parody of Jacques-Louis David’s THE CORONATION OF NAPOLEON, painted exactly like the real enormous canvas: Neoclassical oil, smooth glazing, warm gold and crimson palette, old varnish, a packed ceremonial hall with a crowd of dignitaries in tiers. Same central action: a standing man on the dais raising a crown in both hands above a woman kneeling before him with hands folded, her long train spread behind her, onlookers crowding both sides. The man is young BIDAM (attached white-robed portrait: face and white horse-embroidered robe over plum hanbok); he lifts a SILLA GOLD CROWN with tree-shaped uprights and dangling jade over PRINCESS DUKMAN (attached portrait: face and garments, hair ornament matching the attached binyeo ref) in vermilion #E8552B silk. The hall is a Silla palace of red timber pillars and lattice; the crowd are True Bone nobles in court silk, several looking sour. PARODY RULES: always a hand-made PAINTING, never photoreal. Reproduce the original work’s composition, poses and signature look so it reads instantly as that exact work, with our characters swapped in. If the original is a painting, mural, print or scroll, match its medium, surface and brushwork. If the original is a photograph, film poster, album cover, anime frame or statue, PAINT it: a painterly illustration of that image with visible brushstrokes, simplified forms and anime-adjacent faces, NOT a photo, NOT photoreal skin or pores, NOT a 3D render, NOT a CGI statue. FACE AND GARMENTS from the attached portraits, recognizable but restyled into the medium; never the portrait’s standing clasped-hands stance. Character hex lives only as real color inside the work (pigment, cloth, light), never a glow aura, halo, emissive skin or neon outline. If a sword is visible it is the ring-pommel 환두대도 (small ring pommel at the heel of the fist, short grip, long straight blade, handle:blade 1:3), never a katana, never a tsuba. No readable text, no title, no credits, no legible inscriptions or signatures (red seal stamps only as blank red squares), no logos, no watermark.

images.alt: Yushin and Bidam sit back to back against a tally post of even notches in the torchlit yard, each grinning over his shoulder at the other
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 2:1 still composed like a symbolic old-master history painting — ETERNAL FRIENDS AND RIVALS, THE TWO GREATEST MEN IN SAMHAN. Night on the packed-earth Hwarang yard after the day’s bout, camera low at ground level. BLOCKING: Yushin and Bidam sit on the ground back to back, one on each side of a weathered wooden post, both leaning their backs against it so their shoulders touch behind it; Yushin faces frame-left, Bidam frame-right, a mirror image. Both are spent and grinning, each turning his head over his shoulder toward the other to trade a jab. Knees up, forearms resting on them, empty-handed; Bidam’s 108 dark beads looped around his wrist. No weapons in frame. ONE DEVICE: the post rises straight up the centre of the frame between them, scored with two even columns of plain knife-cut tally notches, one column per man — no characters, no writing. A single torch planted in the dirt at the side rakes up across both faces, the blue robe, the white robe, the beads and the notches. A giwa hall dissolving in navy haze behind. Foreground: drifting dust and ember bokeh. Faces drawn, matching the attached portraits. No text. CANON — BIDAM — FACE and garments from attached /ch_bidam.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Tall, handsome, clean-shaven; short slicked-back black hair; warm brown eyes, faint self-amused smile. Dress: Long white outer robe whose sleeves are embroidered with galloping horses, over a plum-magenta inner robe and white sash. Navy #141C2E lives in the room and on the beads, not on his clothes. Demeanor: Buddhist: 108 beads wrapped on the wrist or rolling through his fingers, lotus seat, incense, a sutra under his breath; calm, ironic, never hurried. In anger the smile stays and the eyes go flat. #141C2E as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: headband; Confucian rank tablet; navy glow aura; dual swords. | KIM YUSHIN — FACE and garments from attached /ch_kim_yushin.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Tall, broad-shouldered, long black hair in a high topknot-ponytail with trailing Silla-blue cloth tails; level hard brows, deep-set eyes. Dress: Silla-blue po and trousers, plum-violet sash knotted at the waist, white inner collar, dark wrapped forearms. Off duty: plain blue po, no jewelry. Now: Marshal: full black beard and moustache; a blue ribbon in the topknot instead of the headband. Demeanor: Confucian: he STANDS — never sits in lotus. Weighs, counts, frowns at sums; tight jaw, rare dry half-smile. Grief shows as stillness, not tears. The most feared warrior in all of Samhan: a line goes quiet when the tall Silla helm and the white horse appear. Massive, deliberate, terrifying at a walk; by Hwangsan (65) heavier and slower than Gyebek but still the man armies are built around. #2A5FB8 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: sitting in lotus or holding prayer beads; katana, tsuba or curved blade (ignore the sword drawn on his portrait); two swords at once; blue glow aura. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. blocks.html: One night earlier. Six nobles, one brazier, and nobody stands up until they all agree.
blocks.ko: 하룻밤 전. 귀족 여섯, 화로 하나. 뜻이 모두 같아질 때까지 아무도 일어서지 않는다.

blocks.label: The Night Before
blocks.ko: 전날 밤

blocks.hanja: 和白
blocks.html: Hwabek. It means “speaking in harmony,” which is the polite way of saying nobody goes home. It is older than the bone ranks, older than the Buddha in Silla, and it still picks the kings.
blocks.ko: 화백. ‘어울려 말한다’는 뜻이다. 아무도 집에 못 간다는 말을 점잖게 한 것이다. 골품보다 오래됐고, 신라에 부처가 오기보다 오래됐고, 지금도 임금을 고른다.

blocks.html: Night in a small pavilion off the pond. Someone lights the small brazier. The flame is red first.
blocks.ko: 연못가 작은 정자다. 누가 화로에 불을 붙인다. 불꽃은 먼저 붉다.

blocks.html: It runs hotter. The flame turns blue. Only then may the session start.
blocks.ko: 불이 더 뜨거워진다. 불꽃이 푸르게 바뀐다. 그제야 회의가 시작된다.

blocks.html: Each sleeve has a cup of tea and a wooden piece on a personal mat. They vote by setting the piece on either side of the cup.
blocks.ko: 소매마다 차 한 잔과 개인 자리보 위의 나무패가 있다. 잔의 좌우에 패를 놓는 것이 표다.

blocks.html: The Council decides by unanimity. One voice against is enough to stop a name. That is why it takes all night.
blocks.ko: 화백은 만장일치로 정한다. 반대 하나면 이름이 멈춘다. 그래서 밤이 샌다.

blocks.title: Harmony Council · 화백회의
blocks.caption: Six seats, one motion. Initial vote, deliberation, final vote: all six, or the name dies in the room.
blocks.ko: 자리 여섯, 안건 하나. 초투표, 숙고, 최종 투표. 여섯 모두가 아니면 그 이름은 방에서 죽는다.

blocks.title: The Three Counts · 세 번의 셈

blocks.label: The Same Pavilion
blocks.ko: 그 정자

blocks.html: Same pavilion. Same pond. Same brazier. Fifty-three winters before tonight, six sleeves sat here and unmade a king.
blocks.ko: 같은 정자, 같은 연못, 같은 화로. 오늘 밤보다 쉰세 해 앞서, 여섯 소매가 여기 앉아 왕 하나를 끌어내렸다.

blocks.html: The king they are counting has had the throne four years, and he is one corridor away. Nobody invited him. In this room a king is not a guest. He is the question.
blocks.ko: 그들이 세는 왕은 왕좌에 앉은 지 네 해째이고, 복도 하나 건너에 있다. 아무도 그를 부르지 않았다. 이 방에서 왕은 손님이 아니다. 안건이다.

blocks.html: The charge has a woman in it. Dohwa, a married woman of the city, told the king that a wife does not serve two husbands. The king asked what would happen if her husband were dead. The city has been asking the same thing ever since.
blocks.ko: 죄목엔 여인이 하나 끼어 있다. 도성의 유부녀 도화는 왕에게, 계집은 두 지아비를 섬기지 않는다고 했다. 왕은 물었다. 그럼 지아비가 죽으면 어떠냐고. 도성은 그 뒤로 내내 같은 걸 묻고 있다.

blocks.html: Nobody in the pavilion says her name. They say “misconduct,” which is cheaper.
blocks.ko: 정자 안에서 그 이름을 입에 올리는 사람은 없다. 다들 ‘부덕’이라고 한다. 그쪽이 싸게 먹히니까.

blocks.html: The brazier goes red, then blue. The first count goes on the cups: six pieces on the no side. Nobody needs to argue, and nobody does.
blocks.ko: 화로가 붉었다가 푸르러진다. 첫 셈이 잔 옆에 놓인다. 여섯 말이 모두 아니오 쪽이다. 따질 필요가 없고, 아무도 따지지 않는다.

blocks.html: Then the door opens. The king has come to his own count, which is not done.
blocks.ko: 그때 문이 열린다. 왕이 제 셈을 보러 왔다. 그러는 법이 아니다.

en: You would unseat a Sacred Bone for a night’s rumor?
…Say her name, then. One of you.
We are not here about the woman, Majesty.
We are here about the next one.
lines: 그 여인 일로 모인 게 아니옵니다, 마마.

en: Then I’ll sit. A king may sit in his own—
lines: 그럼 앉겠다. 제 나라 정자에 임금이—

en: Not on that mat, Majesty. That one votes.
lines: 그 자리는 아니 되옵니다, 마마. 그 자리는 표를 던지는 자리옵니다.

blocks.html: He stands through the deliberation, and through the final count. Six pieces stay where they are. The brazier stays blue. It is very quiet, for a thing that ends a reign.
blocks.ko: 그는 선 채로 의논을 듣고, 마지막 셈을 본다. 여섯 말은 제자리에 있다. 화로는 푸른 채다. 한 임금의 치세가 끝나는 일치고는 아주 조용하다.

blocks.html: In the corridor a boy of eleven waits in a robe hemmed that evening. The lords bow to him on the way out. By morning he is King Jinpyung. His eldest daughter will be the next name this room argues over all night.
blocks.ko: 복도엔 그날 저녁에 단을 접어 올린 두루마기를 입은 열한 살 소년이 기다린다. 나가던 대등들이 그에게 절한다. 아침이 되면 그는 진평왕이다. 그의 맏딸이 이 방이 밤새 다툴 다음 이름이 된다.

blocks.html: At the far end of the corridor the lamps go out one by one. Six sleeves file past. The house that woke up Sacred Bone goes to bed True Bone.
blocks.ko: 복도 저 끝에서 등불이 하나씩 꺼진다. 소매 여섯이 줄지어 지나간다. 성골로 눈을 뜬 그 집은 진골로 잠든다.

blocks.html: He ruled the country four years. His government fell into disorder and he gave himself to debauchery, and the people of the country deposed him.
blocks.ko: 나라를 다스린 지 네 해, 정사가 어지럽고 음란에 빠지니 나라 사람들이 그를 폐하였다.
blocks.hanja: 御國四年。政亂荒婬。國人廢之。
blocks.source: Samguk Yusa (三國遺事) bk. 1, Marvels (紀異) — Dohwa-nyeo and Bihyeong-rang

blocks.html: Six mats unmade a king in this room. Tonight they are being asked to make a queen.
blocks.ko: 이 방에서 여섯 자리가 왕 하나를 끌어내렸다. 오늘 밤 그 자리들은 여왕 하나를 세우라는 청을 받는다.

blocks.html: One of tonight’s six was in the room that night too, at the end of the table with a brush. Eulje is seventy-seven now. Nobody has to explain the rules to him.
blocks.ko: 오늘 밤 여섯 가운데 하나는 그날 밤에도 이 방에 있었다. 탁자 끝에서 붓을 들고. 을제는 이제 일흔일곱이다. 그에게 규칙을 설명해 줄 사람은 없다.

blocks.html: Six seats. Yushin has none. He has a wall, and he is leaning on it, because the Marshal was invited to answer questions, not to ask them.
blocks.ko: 자리는 여섯. 유신의 자리는 없다. 벽이 있고, 그는 거기 기대어 있다. 대장군은 물음에 답하라고 부른 것이지, 물으라고 부른 게 아니다.

blocks.html: The first count is three to three. A hung jury in silk.
blocks.ko: 초투표는 셋 대 셋. 비단 옷 입은 배심이 갈렸다.

blocks.html: Three pieces go to the yes side of the cup. Three go to the no side.
blocks.ko: 패 셋은 잔의 찬성 쪽, 셋은 반대 쪽.

blocks.title: Initial vote · 초투표 3:3
blocks.caption: Three sleeves for Dukman, three against a woman on the throne. Deliberation is the only door.
blocks.ko: 덕만을 드는 소매 셋, 여왕을 막는 소매 셋. 숙고만이 문이다.

blocks.html: Then the names start. Somebody always tries a man first.
blocks.ko: 이제 이름들이 오간다. 누군가는 꼭 남자 이름부터 꺼낸다.

en: Prince Chunchu, then. His mother is royal.
lines: 그럼 춘추 공은 어떻소. 어머니가 성골이오.

en: And his father isn’t. Chunmyung’s boy is a Noble, Murim. By your own rule.
lines: 아버지는 아니잖소. 천명 공주의 아들은 진골이오, 무림 공. 공의 규칙대로라면.

blocks.html: Chunchu is not in the room. He was nine when he learned why.
blocks.ko: 춘추는 그 방에 없다. 왜 없는지는 아홉 살 때 배웠다.

blocks.html: Chunchu is nine. His father wakes him past midnight, which is normal, and walks him to the stream below the palace, which isn't. Kim Yongsu is the son of a king the Council threw out. The capital has a word for him that it only says after he leaves. He talks to the dark. He laughs a beat late. He adds a granary ledger faster than the clerk can read it.
blocks.ko: 춘추는 아홉 살이다. 자정 넘어 아버지가 그를 깨우는 건 흔한 일이고, 궁 아래 개울로 데려가는 건 흔치 않다. 김용수는 화백이 끌어내린 왕의 아들이다. 도성엔 그가 방을 나간 뒤에만 쓰는 말이 있다. 그는 어둠에 대고 말한다. 한 박자 늦게 웃는다. 곳간 장부는 서기가 읽는 것보다 빨리 머릿속으로 더한다.

blocks.html: Tonight he is laying flat stones across the water by lamplight, one at a time, as if someone on the far bank were waiting for the bridge to be finished before dawn.
blocks.ko: 오늘 밤 그는 등불 아래서 납작한 돌을 하나씩 물 위에 놓고 있다. 건너편 기슭의 누군가가 새벽 전에 다리가 끝나기를 기다리고 있기라도 한 것처럼.

lines: ……아니, 찾지 마라. 쳐다보는 거 싫어한다. 내맨치로.
en: Shh. They’re working.
…No, don’t look for them. They hate being looked at. Like me.
Father… who is?

lines: 니 할아버지가 그 큰 자리에 네 해 앉았다. 세 번 세고 나서, 방이 도로 가져갔제.
그 방은 자길 즐겁게 해 주는 사람을 먹어.
그러이까— 그 방엔 들어가지 마래이. 다른 데 앉아라. 다리 위에 앉든가.
en: Your grandfather sat in the big chair four years. Three counts, and the room took it back.
That room eats the men who amuse it.
So— stay out of that room. Sit anywhere else. Sit on the bridge.
…If not in the room, where does a person sit?
(laughs, a beat late)
Wherever the room has to come to you.

blocks.html: By morning there is a bridge of flat stones across the stream that nobody in the palace remembers ordering. The servants say goblins. Chunchu, who carried the lamp, says nothing at all, and finds he is good at it.
blocks.ko: 아침이 되자 개울 위에 납작한 돌다리가 놓여 있다. 궁에서 그걸 시킨 기억이 있는 사람은 없다. 하인들은 도깨비라고 한다. 등불을 들었던 춘추는 아무 말도 하지 않는다. 그리고 자기가 그걸 잘한다는 걸 안다.

blocks.html: Tonight Chunchu is sitting on the rail of the little bridge over the pond. Every man who leaves the pavilion will have to pass him.
blocks.ko: 오늘 밤, 춘추는 연못 위 작은 다리 난간에 앉아 있다. 정자를 나서는 사내는 누구든 그 앞을 지나야 한다.

en: The Kim of Gaya, then. The Marshal’s blood is royal.
lines: 그럼 가야 김씨는. 대장군의 피는 왕족이오.

en: Royal in a country that no longer exists.
If we start counting kingdoms that no longer exist, half this room is royal.
lines: 없어진 나라까지 세기 시작하면, 이 방 절반이 왕족이오.

blocks.html: By the wall, Yushin does not move. He has heard it before. He will hear it again.
blocks.ko: 벽 앞의 유신은 꿈쩍하지 않는다. 전에도 들은 말이다. 또 듣게 될 말이다.

blocks.caption: Yushin’s old yardmate. Blunt, folksy, and the only man on the Council who has killed a tiger.
blocks.ko: 유신의 연무장 동기. 투박하고 구수하고, 화백에서 호랑이를 잡아 본 유일한 사내.

en: Three left, and all of them in skirts.
Well. Somebody say something new, or we’re here till the frost.
lines: 남은 피는 셋, 셋 다 치마요.
자. 누가 새 말 좀 하시오. 아니면 서리 올 때까지 여기 있을 거요.

blocks.html: The newest member of the Council — a Hwarang barely seated among them — stands up.
blocks.ko: 회의의 가장 새로운 일원 — 겨우 자리를 얻은 젊은 화랑 하나가 일어선다.

blocks.caption: The youngest sleeve in the room. He has never once waited his turn.
blocks.ko: 방에서 가장 어린 소매. 한 번도 제 차례를 기다린 적이 없다.

lines: 어른들께서 오늘 밤 한 마디만 마흔 번 하셨습니다. «여자».
저는 덕만공주를 어릴 적부터 뵈어 왔습니다.
이 방 어느 분도, 그분이 답하지 못할 물음을 던져 보신 적이 없습니다.
법화경에서는 용녀가, 비구들이 반대하기도 전에 성불합니다. 저도 읽었고, 어르신들도 읽으셨지요.
성골이 셋뿐이라면, 저는 그 셋 중 가장 총명한 분을 택하겠습니다.
en: My lords have said one word forty times tonight. “Woman.”
I have known Princess Dukman since I was a boy.
Not one of you has ever put a question to her that she could not answer.
In the Lotus Sutra a dragon girl becomes a Buddha faster than the monks can object. I’ve read it. So have you, my lords.
If only three of the Sacred Bone remain, then I choose the cleverest of the three.

lines: …총명하다는 걸로 왕을 고르면, 내일은 누구 말을 듣소.
en: …If cleverness picks a king, whose cleverness do we hear tomorrow.
Bone is the measure. Bone does not change.

lines: 바닥난 뼈로 나라를 버티는 게, 총명한 여왕보다 더 위험하지 않소.
en: The bone has run out.
Holding a country on empty bone is more dangerous than a clever woman.

blocks.html: Murim looks at the brazier for a long time. Then he moves his piece without a word, the way a man pays a debt he has decided not to argue about. Four to two.
blocks.ko: 무림은 한참 화로를 본다. 그러고는 말없이 패를 옮긴다. 따지지 않기로 한 빚을 갚는 사람처럼. 넷 대 둘.

lines: 한 밤의 연설로 삼백 년을 뒤집기엔, 이 방이 너무 오래됐소.
en: I still… cannot raise my hand.
This room is too old to be turned by one night’s speech.

lines: 답이 왔소. 이 방의 절반은 질문도 안 던져 보고 여자라는 단어만 반복했소.
숙고가 그래서 있는 거요. 초투표를 뒤집으라고.
en: I have put questions to her.
They were answered. Half this room never asked — they only repeated the word woman.
That is what deliberation is for. To overturn the first count.
Alchun. You’ve wrestled worse than a woman.
lines: 알천. 자네는 여자보다 무서운 것과도 붙어 봤잖나.

en: I have taken a tiger.
A tiger has no sex. It has teeth.
…I raise it.

blocks.html: Then a great tiger burst in among the seats. The lords leapt up. Lord Alchun barely moved. He went on talking and laughing, caught the tiger by the tail, dashed it to the ground and killed it. Such was Alchun's strength that he took the head of the mat. Yet all the lords bowed to Yushin's authority.
blocks.ko: 그때 큰 호랑이가 자리 한가운데로 뛰어들었다. 여러 공이 놀라 일어났으나 알천공은 조금도 움직이지 않았다. 태연히 웃으며 이야기하다가 호랑이 꼬리를 잡아 땅에 메쳐 죽였다. 알천공의 완력이 이와 같아 윗자리에 앉았다. 그러나 여러 공은 모두 유신의 위엄에 복종하였다.
blocks.hanja: 時有大虎走入座間。諸公驚起。而閼川公略不移動。談笑自若。捉虎尾撲於地而殺之。閼川公膂力如此。處於席首。然諸公皆服庾信之威。
blocks.source: Samguk Yusa (三國遺事) bk. 1, Marvels (紀異) — the lords' council on Namsan's Ujiam rock

blocks.html: Five to one. Every face in the pavilion turns to the oldest sleeve in it. One voice against is still enough.
blocks.ko: 다섯 대 하나. 정자 안의 모든 얼굴이 가장 늙은 소매에게로 돌아간다. 반대 하나면 여전히 충분하다.

blocks.html: Suljong’s hand is on his piece. It stays there. The brazier, which was blue, is going red again.
blocks.ko: 술종의 손이 패 위에 있다. 그대로 있다. 푸르던 화롯불이 다시 붉어지고 있다.

en: You want me to say she can do it. I don’t know that.
Nobody in this room knows that.
lines: 그분이 해낼 수 있다고 말하라는 거요. 나는 그걸 모르오.

en: No, my lord. Nobody does.
A raft isn’t ashamed of the river. You don’t have to believe in her. Just move the piece to the other side of the cup.
Then call it ridiculous all the way home. Nobody counts the grumbling. They count the pieces.
lines: 뗏목은 강을 부끄러워하지 않습니다. 그분을 믿으실 필요는 없습니다. 패만 잔 건너편으로 옮기십시오.
그리고 댁에 가시는 내내 우습다고 하십시오. 투덜거림은 아무도 세지 않습니다. 세는 건 패입니다.

en: …Ridiculous.

blocks.html: He moves the piece. All six sit on the yes side. He will say the word again in the morning, in a corridor, not quite quietly enough.
blocks.ko: 그가 패를 옮긴다. 여섯이 모두 찬성 쪽에 앉는다. 아침에 그는 그 말을 한 번 더 한다. 어느 복도에서, 충분히 작지 않은 목소리로.

blocks.title: Final vote · 최종 투표 6:0
blocks.caption: Deliberation turns the hung room. Six sleeves. The gate opens.
blocks.ko: 숙고가 미결을 뒤집는다. 소매 여섯. 문이 열린다.

en: …That boy Bidam hasn’t an ounce of fear in him.

blocks.html: Across the floor, Yushin catches the Second Blade's eye. He and Bidam have been trading wins since they were boys in the yard. The count stands at one hundred and eight apiece. Neither lets the other stay ahead for long.
blocks.ko: 마루 건너, 유신이 제이검과 눈을 맞춘다. 그와 비담은 연무장 소년 시절부터 승패를 주고받아 왔다. 수는 백팔 대 백팔. 어느 쪽도 상대를 오래 앞서 두지 않는다.

en: Well stood.
Tomorrow on the yard, the hundred-and-ninth is mine.
Ha. Listen to him.
You still owe me a jar from the hundred-and-eighth, old boy. Pay that first.
Today is the country’s business. Tomorrow you can lose to me again.
lines: 하. 이 사람 말하는 거 좀 보래이.
백여덟째 판 술 한 동이부터 갚아라.
오늘은 나라 일이고. 내일 또 지게 해 주꾸마.

blocks.label: Dawn
blocks.ko: 새벽

blocks.html: The brazier is out by the time Alchun carries the six pieces to the princess’s door. He carries them in his fist, because nobody told him there was a box.
blocks.ko: 알천이 여섯 개의 패를 공주의 문 앞까지 들고 갈 무렵, 화로는 꺼져 있다. 그는 패를 주먹에 쥐고 간다. 담는 함이 있다는 걸 아무도 일러 주지 않았으니까.

en: All six?
All six, Princess. Took till the fire went out.
There’ll be talk. The old men are already at it. “There hasn’t been a real king since the Cloud King.”
lines: 여섯 다요, 공주님. 불 꺼질 때까지 걸렸소.
말이 많을 끼요. 늙은이들은 벌써 그카고 있소. “구름왕 이후로 임금다운 임금이 없었다”고.

en: My great-grandfather. They say that at every crowning.
…Four stones on four mountains, and a yard full of boys. And now me.
lines: ……네 산에 비석 넷, 사내아이로 가득한 마당. 그리고 이제 나.

en: We all came out of that yard. Every man who voted tonight.
lines: 우리 다 그 마당에서 나왔소. 오늘 밤 패를 놓은 사내들 전부.

en: Then find me someone who remembers him. Not the stones. The man.
If I’m going to be measured against him, I’d like to see the ruler.
lines: 그라믄 그분을 기억하는 사람을 찾아 도. 비석 말고, 사람으로.
그분한테 재어질 거라면, 그 자부터 봐야겠어.

blocks.label: The Peonies
blocks.ko: 모란 그림

blocks.html: A few weeks after the crowning, word reaches Chang’an too. The emperor of the West has opinions as well.
blocks.ko: 즉위 몇 주 뒤, 소식이 장안에도 닿는다. 서국의 황제에게도 할 말이 있다.

lines: 여자 임금이라… 동이 오랑캐들이 또 시작이로구나.
꽃이나 보내 주어라. 그 여인에게 어울리는 것으로.
en: A woman king… those Samhan barbarians are at it again, aren’t they?
Send her flowers. Something that suits her.
zh: 女主……東夷又在胡鬧了，是不是？武！備袞龍袍。
zhLatn: Nǚzhǔ… Dōngyí yòu zài húnào le, shì bu shì? Wǔ! Bèi gǔnlóngpáo.

blocks.html: He sends her a gift: a painting of peonies in three colours, and a packet of their seeds.
blocks.ko: 그는 선물을 보낸다. 세 가지 빛깔의 모란을 그린 그림 한 폭과, 그 씨앗 한 봉지.

en: …There are no butterflies on these flowers.
Lovely work. The Western brushwork, three colours of— Majesty?
lines: 훌륭한 솜씨입니다. 서국 붓놀림에, 세 가지 빛깔의— 폐하?
…그리고 황제께서는, 내게 지아비가 없는 걸 알아채셨다고 내가 알아주기를 바라시는 게지.
en: It means no scent.
…And the Second Emperor would like me to know he has noticed I have no husband.
…I’d have hung it in the hall.
Somebody remind me never to play go with Her Majesty.
lines: 폐하와는 바둑을 두지 말라고, 누가 좀 일러 주십시오.

blocks.html: She has the seeds planted anyway. When they bloom, they have no scent. The court decides she is a sage. She knows she simply reads people.
blocks.ko: 그래도 씨앗은 심게 한다. 꽃이 피었을 때, 과연 향이 없었다. 조정은 그녀를 신령하다 여긴다. 그녀 자신은 그저 사람을 읽을 줄 아는 것뿐임을 안다.

blocks.html: The council made a queen. Four winters later, five hundred Baekje men come to find out what she’s made of…!
blocks.ko: 화백이 여왕을 만들었다. 네 겨울 뒤, 백제 사내 오백이 그 여왕이 무엇으로 만들어졌는지 보러 온다…!

logline.en: Four winters into the queen’s reign, war drums send two old Hwarang west, to a valley with a polite name.
logline.ko: 여왕 즉위 네 해째 겨울, 전고가 늙은 화랑 둘을 서쪽으로 내몬다. 이름만은 점잖은 골짜기로.
